name: parallel-active-worktree-file-overlap-guard
title: Detect active worktree file overlaps in parallel merge queue
description: Fix a real parallel-development correctness gap: multiple active story worktrees can modify the same source file without parallel_merge_queue seeing the overlap unless sharedHotspots were manually declared. Lattice CLI should mechanically detect actual changed-file overlaps across active worktrees and degrade or block parallel DEV guidance without claiming Authority completion.
